units.source_text: 第二的野心一旦成了沉重的负担，我又回到第一的幻想——金阁遭受空袭。

en.t: Once my second ambition became a heavy burden, I returned again to my first fantasy: the Golden Pavilion being struck by an air raid.

units.source_text: 这种幻想被母亲直率的现实判断破坏以后，又回到第二的野心上来。

en.t: After that fantasy was destroyed by my mother's blunt, realistic judgment, I turned back again to the second ambition.

units.source_text: 过分的胡思乱想，结果闹得我后脖颈根上长出一个红肿的大疙瘩。

en.t: As a result of my excessive brooding and wild imaginings, a large red swollen lump appeared at the base of the back of my neck.
